sections.title: Attribution list page
sections.what: Shows each data source with its credit text, what it allows, and its notes, then adds a fixed font credit line.
sections.why: The comment says the list is generated from the rights policies so it matches what the app really enforces.
sections.watch_out: The font credit line is typed by hand, so it must be updated if the fonts change.

summary: A public page that lists every data source the app uses, with its attribution text and what its licence allows.
purpose: Meets the credit and licence duties for data and fonts.
why: The comment says the page is generated from the same rights policy files that control storage and display, so it stays accurate.
how: 1) Loads all rights policies. 2) Shows each source with its attribution and yes or no answers for display, storage, model training, prototype use and commercial use. 3) Adds a fixed font credit line.
inputs: The rights policies from the rights provider.
outputs: A static page with one section per data source.
risks: The font credit line is typed by hand, so it can drift from the font packages.
debug: If a source is missing, check the rights policy files. If an answer looks wrong, check the matching policy field.
